"""Parsing helpers for pytae CLI flag values (pure string parsing; no pandas/pipeline state)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import difflib
import glob
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Sequence

from pytae._parsing import FilterNode, _parse_dict_literal, _parse_filter_node
from pytae._text import _is_enclosed_pair
from pytae._text import tokenize as _tokenize
from pytae._text import unquote_name as _unquote_name

SELECT_KEYS = ("dtype", "exclude_dtype", "contains", "startswith", "endswith", "regex")


def parse_columns(raw: str) -> list[str]:
    """Parse a column list like "'col a','col b'" or "col_a,col_b" or "[col a], [col b]" into a list of names."""
    raw = raw.strip()
    if _is_enclosed_pair(raw, "[", "]") and "," in raw:
        raw = raw[1:-1].strip()
    try:
        parsed = ast.literal_eval(f"[{raw}]")
        cols = list(parsed) if isinstance(parsed, (list, tuple)) else [parsed]
        return [_unquote_name(str(c).strip()) for c in cols]
    except (ValueError, SyntaxError):
        tokens = _tokenize(raw, ",", track_brackets=True)
        return [_unquote_name(c.strip()) for c in tokens if c.strip()]


def parse_distinct_spec(raw: str | None) -> tuple[list[str], str | bool]:
    """Parse -distinct SPEC into (cols, keep).

    Canonical syntax:
      - Bare flag / "": all columns, keep='first'
      - "col1,col2": subset of columns, keep='first'
      - "keep=last": all columns, keep='last'
      - "keep=false" or "keep=none": all columns, keep=False (drop all duplicates)
      - "col1,col2,keep=last": subset of columns, keep='last'
    """
    if not raw or not raw.strip():
        return [], "first"

    tokens = [t.strip() for t in _tokenize(raw, ",", track_brackets=True) if t.strip()]
    cols: list[str] = []
    keep: str | bool = "first"

    for token in tokens:
        if token.startswith("keep="):
            val = token[len("keep=") :].strip().strip("'\"").lower()
            if val in ("first", "last"):
                keep = val
            elif val in ("false", "none"):
                keep = False
            else:
                raise SystemExit(f"-distinct: invalid keep value '{val}'. Expected 'first', 'last', 'false', or 'none'")
        else:
            cols.append(_unquote_name(token))

    return cols, keep


def parse_count_spec(raw: str | None) -> tuple[list[str], bool, str]:
    """Parse -count SPEC into (cols, sort, name).

    Canonical syntax:
      - Bare flag / "": all columns (or grouped keys if after -by), sort=True, name='n'
      - "col1,col2": subset of columns, sort=True, name='n'
      - "col1,sort=false": subset of columns, sort=False, name='n'
      - "col1,name=total": subset of columns, sort=True, name='total'
      - "sort=false,name=count": all columns, sort=False, name='count'
    """
    if not raw or not raw.strip():
        return [], True, "n"

    tokens = [t.strip() for t in _tokenize(raw, ",", track_brackets=True) if t.strip()]
    cols: list[str] = []
    sort: bool = True
    name: str = "n"

    for token in tokens:
        if token.startswith("sort="):
            val = token[len("sort=") :].strip().strip("'\"").lower()
            if val in ("true", "1", "yes"):
                sort = True
            elif val in ("false", "0", "no"):
                sort = False
            else:
                raise SystemExit(f"-count: invalid sort value '{val}'. Expected 'true' or 'false'")
        elif token.startswith("name="):
            name = _unquote_name(token[len("name=") :].strip())
        else:
            cols.append(_unquote_name(token))

    return cols, sort, name


def parse_dropna_spec(
    raw: str | None,
    flag_name: str = "-dropna",
    available_cols: Sequence[str] | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[str], str | None, bool]:
    """Parse -dropna SPEC into (cols, how, drop_nans).

    Zero-Data-Loss Safety Defaults:
      - Bare flag / "": cols=[], how=None (defaults to 'all' to prevent accidental data loss), drop_nans=True
      - "col1,col2": cols=['col1', 'col2'], how=None (defaults to 'any' for targeted columns), drop_nans=True
      - "how=any" or "how=all": cols=[], how='any'/'all', drop_nans=True
      - "col1,col2,how=all": cols=['col1', 'col2'], how='all', drop_nans=True
      - "drop_nans=false": drop_nans=False
    """
    if not raw or not raw.strip():
        return [], None, True

    tokens = [t.strip() for t in _tokenize(raw, ",", track_brackets=True) if t.strip()]
    cols: list[str] = []
    how: str | None = None
    drop_nans: bool = True

    for token in tokens:
        if re.match(r"^how\s*[:=]\s*", token, re.IGNORECASE):
            val = re.sub(r"^how\s*[:=]\s*", "", token, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip().strip("'\"").lower()
            if val in ("any", "all"):
                how = val
            else:
                raise SystemExit(f"{flag_name}: invalid how value '{val}'. Expected 'any' or 'all'")
        elif re.match(r"^(drop_nans|nans)\s*[:=]\s*", token, re.IGNORECASE):
            val = re.sub(r"^(drop_nans|nans)\s*[:=]\s*", "", token, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip().strip("'\"").lower()
            drop_nans = val not in ("false", "0", "no")
        elif token.lower() in ("any", "all"):
            if available_cols and token in available_cols:
                cols.append(_unquote_name(token))
            else:
                how = token.lower()
        else:
            cols.append(_unquote_name(token))

    return cols, how, drop_nans


def parse_fillna_spec(
    raw: str | None,
    flag_name: str = "-fillna",
    available_cols: Sequence[str] | None = None,
) -> tuple[Any, list[str] | None, bool]:
    """Parse -fillna SPEC into (value, cols, nans).

    Syntax examples:
      - '0': value=0, cols=None, nans=True
      - '.': value='.', cols=None, nans=True
      - 'a:0, b:N/A': value={'a': 0, 'b': 'N/A'}, cols=None, nans=True
      - '0, a, b': value=0, cols=['a', 'b'], nans=True
      - '0, a, b, nans=false': value=0, cols=['a', 'b'], nans=False
    """
    raw = (raw or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        raise SystemExit(f"{flag_name}: expected fill value, column mapping (col:val), or 'val, col1, col2'")

    tokens = [t.strip() for t in _tokenize(raw, ",", keep_quotes=True, track_brackets=True) if t.strip()]
    nans = True
    clean_tokens: list[str] = []
    for t in tokens:
        if re.match(r"^nans\s*[:=]\s*", t, re.IGNORECASE):
            val = re.sub(r"^nans\s*[:=]\s*", "", t, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip().strip("'\"").lower()
            nans = val not in ("false", "0", "no")
        else:
            clean_tokens.append(t)

    if not clean_tokens:
        raise SystemExit(f"{flag_name}: expected fill value")

    # Check if this is a mapping: "a:0, b:N/A"
    is_mapping = all(":" in t or "=" in t for t in clean_tokens)
    if is_mapping:
        mapping: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for t in clean_tokens:
            sep = ":" if ":" in t else "="
            k, _, v = t.partition(sep)
            k_clean = _unquote_name(k.strip())
            v_strip = v.strip()
            try:
                v_val = ast.literal_eval(v_strip)
            except Exception:
                v_val = _unquote_name(v_strip)
            mapping[k_clean] = v_val
        return mapping, None, nans

    first_token = clean_tokens[0]
    try:
        val = ast.literal_eval(first_token)
    except Exception:
        val = _unquote_name(first_token)

    cols = [_unquote_name(c) for c in clean_tokens[1:]] if len(clean_tokens) > 1 else None
    return val, cols, nans


def parse_sort_by(raw: str) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
    """Parse legacy -sort_by SPEC: a comma-separated column list, optionally ending with
    asc or desc as a trailing word (default asc). e.g. "species,body_mass_g desc"."""
    raw = (raw or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        raise SystemExit("-sort_by: expected a column list, optionally followed by asc or desc")
    order = "asc"
    head, sep, tail = raw.rpartition(" ")
    if sep and tail.lower() in ("asc", "desc"):
        raw, order = head.rstrip(",").strip(), tail.lower()
    cols = parse_columns(raw)
    if not cols:
        raise SystemExit("-sort_by: expected a column list, optionally followed by asc or desc")
    return cols, order


def parse_arrange(raw: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[bool]]:
    """Parse -arrange SPEC: a comma-separated column list with optional asc/desc directions,
    leading '-', or brackets for spaced columns. e.g. "species, [annual salary] desc".
    """
    raw = (raw or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        raise SystemExit("-arrange: expected a column list with optional asc/desc directions")
    from pytae._parsing import _extract_arrange_specs

    cols, asc_list = _extract_arrange_specs((raw,))
    if not cols:
        raise SystemExit("-arrange: expected a column list with optional asc/desc directions")
    return cols, asc_list


@dataclass
class SliceSpec:
    n: int | None = None
    prop: float | None = None
    with_ties: bool = False


def parse_head_limit(raw: Any, flag_name: str = "-head") -> SliceSpec:
    """Parse -head or -tail limit argument supporting:
    - 5 (row count, default 5)
    - '10%' (percentage proportion)
    - 0.1 (float proportion)
    - '3, ties=true' (row count with boundary ties)
    - '10%, with_ties=true' (proportion with boundary ties)
    """
    if isinstance(raw, SliceSpec):
        return raw
    if isinstance(raw, int):
        if raw <= 0:
            raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{flag_name}: row count must be > 0, got {raw}")
        return SliceSpec(n=raw, prop=None, with_ties=False)
    if isinstance(raw, float):
        if not (0 < raw <= 1):
            raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{flag_name}: proportion must be between 0 and 1, got {raw}")
        return SliceSpec(n=None, prop=raw, with_ties=False)

    s = str(raw).strip()
    if not s:
        return SliceSpec(n=5, prop=None, with_ties=False)

    tokens = [t.strip() for t in s.split(",") if t.strip()]
    n: int | None = None
    prop: float | None = None
    with_ties: bool = False

    for tok in tokens:
        lowered = tok.lower()
        if lowered in ("ties", "with_ties", "ties=true", "with_ties=true", "ties=1", "with_ties=1"):
            with_ties = True
        elif lowered in ("ties=false", "with_ties=false", "ties=0", "with_ties=0"):
            with_ties = False
        elif tok.startswith("n="):
            v_str = tok[2:].strip()
            try:
                val = int(v_str)
                if val <= 0:
                    raise ValueError
                n = val
            except ValueError:
                raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{flag_name}: invalid n value '{v_str}'; must be a positive integer")
        elif tok.startswith("prop="):
            v_str = tok[5:].strip()
            try:
                p_val = float(v_str.rstrip("%")) / 100.0 if v_str.endswith("%") else float(v_str)
                if not (0 < p_val <= 1):
                    raise ValueError
                prop = p_val
            except ValueError:
                raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(
                    f"{flag_name}: invalid prop value '{v_str}'; must be a number between 0 and 1"
                )
        elif tok.endswith("%"):
            try:
                p_val = float(tok[:-1]) / 100.0
                if not (0 < p_val <= 1):
                    raise ValueError
                prop = p_val
            except ValueError:
                raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(
                    f"{flag_name}: invalid percentage '{tok}'; must be between 0% and 100%"
                )
        else:
            try:
                if "." in tok:
                    p_val = float(tok)
                    if not (0 < p_val <= 1):
                        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{flag_name}: proportion must be between 0 and 1, got {tok}")
                    prop = p_val
                else:
                    val = int(tok)
                    if val <= 0:
                        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{flag_name}: must be > 0, got {val}")
                    n = val
            except ValueError:
                raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{flag_name}: unrecognized limit/argument '{tok}'")

    if n is not None and prop is not None:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{flag_name}: specify either row count 'n' or proportion 'prop', not both")
    if n is None and prop is None:
        n = 5
    return SliceSpec(n=n, prop=prop, with_ties=with_ties)


def parse_pick_spec(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    raise SystemExit(
        "'-pick' has been removed; use '-arrange ... -head N' (or '-by ... -arrange ... -head N') instead."
    )


def _split_tokens(raw: str, sep: str = ",") -> list[str]:
    """Split on sep, respecting quotes and brackets."""
    return [t for t in _tokenize(raw, sep, track_brackets=True) if t]


def _split_groups(raw: str, sep: str = ";") -> list[str]:
    """Split on sep but keep quote characters so inner comma-split still sees them."""
    return [t for t in _tokenize(raw, sep, keep_quotes=True) if t]


def parse_select_spec(raw: str) -> tuple[list[str], dict]:
    """Parse -select into positional names/slices and select() kwargs.

    Tokens without '=' are column names or start:end slices. Tokens like
    dtype=numeric / contains=bill / regex=^flip become kwargs. Repeated keys
    become a list. Union of all tokens, matching pt.select().
    """
    raw = raw.strip()
    if _is_enclosed_pair(raw, "[", "]") and "," in raw:
        raw = raw[1:-1].strip()
    tokens = _split_tokens(raw)

    names: list[str] = []
    kwargs: dict = {}
    for token in tokens:
        if "=" in token:
            key, _, value = token.partition("=")
            key = key.strip()
            value = value.strip()
            if key == "exclude":
                raise SystemExit(
                    "-select: 'exclude=' is retired in favor of '!' negation. "
                    "Use -select '!col' or -select '!col1,!col2' instead."
                )
            if key in SELECT_KEYS:
                if not value:
                    raise SystemExit(f"-select: {key}= needs a value")
                if key in kwargs:
                    prev = kwargs[key]
                    kwargs[key] = (prev if isinstance(prev, list) else [prev]) + [value]
                else:
                    kwargs[key] = value
                continue
        names.append(token)
    if not names and not kwargs:
        raise SystemExit("-select: expected column names and/or key=value tokens")
    if "exclude_dtype" in kwargs and (names or len(kwargs) > 1):
        raise SystemExit("-select: exclude_dtype cannot be combined with other selection criteria")
    return names, kwargs


def _select_unknown_names(tokens: list[str], available: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Exact-name tokens (and slice endpoints) that are not in the file."""
    unknown: list[str] = []
    for token in tokens:
        clean = _unquote_name(token)
        if clean in available:
            continue
        if token.startswith(("-", "~", "!")):
            raw = _unquote_name(token[1:].strip())
            if raw in available:
                continue
            if ":" in raw:
                start, end = raw.split(":", 1)
                start, end = _unquote_name(start.strip()), _unquote_name(end.strip())
                if start and start not in available:
                    unknown.append(start)
                if end and end not in available:
                    unknown.append(end)
            else:
                unknown.append(raw)
        elif ":" in token:
            start, end = token.split(":", 1)
            start, end = _unquote_name(start.strip()), _unquote_name(end.strip())
            if start and start not in available:
                unknown.append(start)
            if end and end not in available:
                unknown.append(end)
        else:
            unknown.append(clean)
    return unknown


def unknown_columns_message(flag: str, requested: list[str], available: list[str]) -> str:
    """Build an 'unknown column(s)' error message, suggesting a close match for likely typos."""
    unknown = [c for c in requested if c not in available]
    parts = []
    for c in unknown:
        close = difflib.get_close_matches(c, available, n=1)
        parts.append(f"'{c}'" + (f" (did you mean '{close[0]}'?)" if close else ""))
    return f"{flag}: unknown column(s): {', '.join(parts)}"


def parse_rename(raw: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Parse a rename mapping like "old_a:new_a,old_b:new_b" into a dict.
    Quoting either side (e.g. "'old a':'new a'") is optional and stripped if present—
    plain old_a:new_a already handles spaces, quoting just needs to not break things."""
    mapping: dict[str, str] = {}
    for pair in raw.split(","):
        pair = pair.strip()
        if not pair:
            continue
        if ":" in pair:
            old, new = pair.split(":", 1)
        elif "=" in pair:
            raise SystemExit(
                f"invalid -rename mapping '{pair}'; use ':' (e.g. -rename 'old:new'). '=' is not supported."
            )
        else:
            raise SystemExit(f"invalid -rename mapping '{pair}'; expected old:new")
        old_clean = _unquote_name(old)
        new_clean = _unquote_name(new)
        if old_clean in mapping and mapping[old_clean] != new_clean:
            raise SystemExit(
                f"invalid -rename: conflicting mappings for '{old_clean}': '{mapping[old_clean]}' and '{new_clean}'"
            )
        mapping[old_clean] = new_clean
    return mapping


def expand_paths(patterns: str | list[str]) -> list[Path]:
    """Expand glob pattern(s) into matching paths, or wrap plain paths as-is."""
    items = [patterns] if isinstance(patterns, str) else list(patterns)
    results: list[Path] = []
    seen: set[Path] = set()
    for item in items:
        p_literal = Path(item)
        if p_literal.exists():
            if p_literal not in seen:
                results.append(p_literal)
                seen.add(p_literal)
        elif any(ch in item for ch in "*?["):
            matches = sorted(Path(p) for p in glob.glob(item))
            if not matches:
                raise SystemExit(f"no files matched pattern: {item}")
            for m in matches:
                if m not in seen:
                    results.append(m)
                    seen.add(m)
        else:
            if p_literal not in seen:
                results.append(p_literal)
                seen.add(p_literal)
    return results


def _split_qry_entries(raw: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Legacy helper for splitting filter conditions into (column, condition) tuples."""
    node = _parse_filter_node(raw)
    out: list[tuple[str, str]] = []

    def _collect(n: Any):
        if hasattr(n, "left") and hasattr(n, "right"):
            _collect(n.left)
            _collect(n.right)
        elif hasattr(n, "col") and hasattr(n, "cond"):
            out.append((n.col, str(n.cond)))

    _collect(node)
    return out


def parse_filter(raw: str) -> FilterNode | dict[str, Any]:
    """Parse -filter conditions like "col == 5 and other in ['a','b']", or dict literal '{"col": 5}'."""
    stripped = raw.strip()
    parsed_dict = _parse_dict_literal(stripped)
    if parsed_dict is not None:
        return parsed_dict
    return _parse_filter_node(stripped)


def parse_qry(raw: str) -> FilterNode | dict[str, Any]:
    """Deprecated alias for parse_filter."""
    return parse_filter(raw)


def parse_agg(raw: str):
    """Parse -agg: a name (mean), a comma list (mean,sum,count), or a col=aggfunc
    mapping (val = sum, n = count, total = v1:sum). Quote a mapping key only to protect a comma."""
    raw = (raw or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return "sum"
    if raw.startswith("{") or (raw.startswith("[") and "=" not in raw):
        raise SystemExit("-agg: use a name (mean), a comma list (mean,sum), or a mapping (col = mean, total = count)")
    entries = [e for e in _tokenize(raw, ",", keep_quotes=True, track_brackets=True) if e]
    if not entries:
        raise SystemExit("-agg: expected a name, a comma list, or a mapping")

    def _is_mapping(entry: str) -> bool:
        return (
            len(_tokenize(entry, "=", keep_quotes=True, track_brackets=True)) >= 2
            or len(_tokenize(entry, ":", keep_quotes=True, track_brackets=True)) >= 2
        )

    mapped = [_is_mapping(e) for e in entries]
    if all(mapped):
        out: dict[str, Any] = {}
        dropna_flag = None
        for entry in entries:
            if "=" in entry:
                parts = _tokenize(entry, "=", keep_quotes=True, track_brackets=True)
                key = _unquote_name(parts[0])
                value = _unquote_name("=".join(parts[1:]))
                if key in ("column", "aggfunc"):
                    raise SystemExit(
                        "-agg: the old 'column=...,aggfunc=...' syntax is retired. "
                        "Use '-by <cols> -agg \"col = aggfunc\"' or '-agg \"total = col:aggfunc\"' instead."
                    )
                if key.lower() == "dropna":
                    dropna_flag = parse_bool_text(value)
                    continue
            elif ":" in entry:
                raise SystemExit(
                    f"-agg: invalid mapping entry '{entry}'; use '=' (e.g. -agg 'col = mean'). Colon ':' is not supported."
                )
            else:
                raise SystemExit(f"-agg: invalid mapping entry {entry!r}")
            if not key or not value:
                raise SystemExit(f"-agg: invalid mapping entry {entry!r}")
            if key in out:
                raise ValueError(f"agg(): output column name '{key}' is duplicated in aggregation specification")
            out[key] = value
        if dropna_flag is not None:
            out["__dropna__"] = dropna_flag
        return out
    if any(mapped):
        raise SystemExit("-agg: mix of names and col=aggfunc mappings; use one or the other")
    names = [_unquote_name(e) for e in entries]
    return names[0] if len(names) == 1 else names


_AGG_KEYS = ("column", "aggfunc", "as")


def parse_group_agg(raw: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """Parse -agg as key=value specs: column=, aggfunc=, optional as=.

    Several specs are separated by ';'. Several source columns in one spec share
    the same aggfunc: column='value,val_growth',aggfunc=sum. as= needs a single column.
    Returns (source_col, output_name, aggfunc) rows.
    """
    raw = (raw or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        raise SystemExit("-agg: expected key=value specs, e.g. column=value,aggfunc=sum,as=v")
    if raw.startswith("{"):
        raise SystemExit("-agg: use key=value specs, e.g. column=value,aggfunc=sum,as=v (not a dict literal)")
    rows: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
    for group in _split_groups(raw, ";"):
        canon = parse_reshape_kwargs(group, keys=_AGG_KEYS, flag="-agg")
        if "column" not in canon or "aggfunc" not in canon:
            raise SystemExit("-agg: each spec needs column= and aggfunc=")
        cols = parse_columns(canon["column"])
        if not cols:
            raise SystemExit("-agg: column= needs at least one column")
        out = canon.get("as")
        if out and len(cols) != 1:
            raise SystemExit("-agg: as= requires a single column")
        aggfunc = canon["aggfunc"]
        for col in cols:
            rows.append((col, out or col, aggfunc))
    names = [name for _, name, _ in rows]
    if len(names) != len(set(names)):
        raise SystemExit("-agg: duplicate output names")
    return rows


_LONG_KEYS = ("cols", "id_vars", "c", "v", "r")
_WIDE_KEYS = ("r", "c", "v")


def parse_reshape_kwargs(raw: str | None, *, keys: tuple[str, ...], flag: str) -> dict:
    """Parse -long/-wide/-pivot as key=value tokens, e.g. c=metric,v=reading,a=mean.
    Comma-separated lists like frames=a,b,c or on=id:id,code:code work with or without quotes."""
    raw = (raw or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return {}
    kwargs: dict = {}
    current_key: str | None = None
    for token in _split_tokens(raw):
        if "=" in token:
            key, _, value = token.partition("=")
            key = key.strip()
            value = _unquote_name(value)
            if flag == "-wide" and key in ("a", "agg", "aggfunc"):
                raise SystemExit(
                    "-wide: -wide is strictly for 1-to-1 reshaping without aggregation. "
                    "Use -pivot for aggregations (e.g. -pivot 'r=...,c=...,v=...,a=...')."
                )
            if key in keys:
                if not value:
                    raise SystemExit(f"{flag}: {key}= needs a value")
                if key in kwargs:
                    raise SystemExit(f"{flag}: {key}= given more than once")
                current_key = key
                kwargs[key] = value
            elif current_key is not None:
                kwargs[current_key] = f"{kwargs[current_key]},{_unquote_name(token)}"
            else:
                raise SystemExit(f"{flag}: unknown key {key!r}; expected {', '.join(keys)}")
        else:
            if current_key is None:
                raise SystemExit(f"{flag}: expected key=value tokens ({', '.join(keys)})")
            kwargs[current_key] = f"{kwargs[current_key]},{_unquote_name(token)}"
    for key, value in list(kwargs.items()):
        if key in ("margins", "exact", "dropna"):
            kwargs[key] = parse_bool_text(value)
        elif key == "f_v":
            if isinstance(value, str):
                v_lower = value.strip().lower()
                if v_lower in ("none", "null"):
                    kwargs[key] = None
                else:
                    try:
                        kwargs[key] = int(value)
                    except ValueError:
                        try:
                            kwargs[key] = float(value)
                        except ValueError:
                            raise SystemExit(f"{flag}: {key}= must be a numeric value or 'none'")
        else:
            kwargs[key] = value
    return kwargs


def parse_long_arg(raw: str | None) -> dict:
    kwargs = parse_reshape_kwargs(raw, keys=_LONG_KEYS, flag="-long")
    if "r" in kwargs:
        if "id_vars" in kwargs:
            raise SystemExit("-long: cannot specify both r= and id_vars=")
        kwargs["id_vars"] = kwargs.pop("r")
    return kwargs


def parse_wide_arg(raw: str | None) -> dict:
    return parse_reshape_kwargs(raw, keys=_WIDE_KEYS, flag="-wide")


_PIVOT_KEYS = ("r", "c", "v", "a", "dropna", "f_v")


def parse_pivot_arg(raw: str | None) -> dict:
    return parse_reshape_kwargs(raw, keys=_PIVOT_KEYS, flag="-pivot")


def parse_bool_text(raw: str) -> bool:
    """Parse a required true/false text flag value into bool."""
    lowered = raw.strip().lower()
    if lowered == "true":
        return True
    if lowered == "false":
        return False
    raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError("expected 'true' or 'false'")


def parse_positive_int(raw) -> int:
    """Parse a row-count flag; reject 0 and negatives (e.g. -head 0, -head -5)."""
    try:
        n = int(raw)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"invalid integer: {raw!r}") from None
    if n <= 0:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"must be > 0, got {n}")
    return n


def parse_fraction(raw) -> float:
    """Parse -frac: a fraction of rows in (0, 1] (e.g. -frac 0.1 for 10%)."""
    try:
        frac = float(raw)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"invalid number: {raw!r}") from None
    if not (0 < frac <= 1):
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"must be > 0 and <= 1, got {frac}")
    return frac


def parse_list_order(raw: str) -> str:
    """Parse optional listing order for -cols/-dtype/-nulls: asc or desc.

    'file' is the internal sentinel used when the flag is present with no value
    (argparse 3.14 type-converts const).
    """
    lowered = str(raw).strip().lower()
    if lowered in ("asc", "desc", "file"):
        return lowered
    raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError("expected 'asc' or 'desc'")


_CLEAN_COLUMNS_BOOL_KEYS = ("strip", "squeeze", "strip_special", "dedupe")
_CLEAN_COLUMNS_KEYS = _CLEAN_COLUMNS_BOOL_KEYS + ("fill", "case")
_CLEAN_COLUMNS_CASE_VALUES = ("lower", "upper", "proper")


def parse_clean_columns_arg(raw: str) -> dict:
    """Parse -clean_columns as key[=value] tokens, comma-separated:

    - strip=, squeeze=, strip_special=, dedupe= — bools (default false); a bare
      key with no '=' means true, e.g. "strip" is short for "strip=true".
    - fill[=STR] — replace whitespace in a header with STR; bare "fill" defaults
      to '_'; omit the key entirely for no fill.
    - case=lower|upper|proper — no bare/default form, always needs a value.
    """
    raw = (raw or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        raise SystemExit('-clean_columns: expected at least one key, e.g. "strip" or "case=lower"')
    kwargs: dict = {}
    for token in _split_tokens(raw):
        key, has_value, value = token.partition("=")
        key = key.strip()
        if key not in _CLEAN_COLUMNS_KEYS:
            raise SystemExit(f"-clean_columns: unknown key {key!r}; expected {', '.join(_CLEAN_COLUMNS_KEYS)}")
        if key in kwargs:
            raise SystemExit(f"-clean_columns: {key}= given more than once")
        if key in _CLEAN_COLUMNS_BOOL_KEYS:
            kwargs[key] = parse_bool_text(_unquote_name(value)) if has_value else True
        elif key == "fill":
            kwargs[key] = _unquote_name(value) if has_value else "_"
        else:  # case
            case_value = _unquote_name(value).strip().lower()
            if not has_value or not case_value:
                raise SystemExit("-clean_columns: case= needs a value (lower, upper, or proper)")
            if case_value not in _CLEAN_COLUMNS_CASE_VALUES:
                raise SystemExit(f"-clean_columns: case= must be one of {', '.join(_CLEAN_COLUMNS_CASE_VALUES)}")
            kwargs[key] = case_value
    return kwargs


_FILE_ENTRY_KEYS = ("dlim", "encoding")


def parse_file_arg(raw: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Parse -file as ';'-separated entries (at least two), each PATH=ALIAS optionally
    followed by ,dlim=/,encoding= overrides for reading that file, e.g.
    "data1.parquet=df1,dlim='|'; data2.parquet=df2,encoding='latin-1'".
    Returns a list of {'path', 'alias', 'dlim', 'encoding'} dicts (dlim/encoding are
    None when not given).
    """
    raw = (raw or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        raise SystemExit("-file: expected at least one PATH=ALIAS entry")
    entries: list[dict] = []
    aliases_seen: set[str] = set()
    for group in _split_groups(raw, ";"):
        tokens = _split_tokens(group, ",")
        if not tokens:
            raise SystemExit("-file: expected PATH=ALIAS")
        head, has_value, alias = tokens[0].partition("=")
        if not has_value or not alias.strip():
            raise SystemExit(f"-file: expected PATH=ALIAS, got {tokens[0]!r}")
        alias = alias.strip()
        if alias in aliases_seen:
            raise SystemExit(f"-file: duplicate alias '{alias}'")
        aliases_seen.add(alias)
        entry = {"path": head.strip(), "alias": alias, "dlim": None, "encoding": None}
        for token in tokens[1:]:
            key, has_kv, value = token.partition("=")
            key = key.strip()
            if not has_kv or key not in _FILE_ENTRY_KEYS:
                raise SystemExit(f"-file: unknown option {token!r}; expected dlim= or encoding=")
            entry[key] = _unquote_name(value)
        entries.append(entry)
    if len(entries) < 2:
        raise SystemExit("-file: need at least two PATH=ALIAS entries")
    return entries


_JOIN_KEYS = ("left", "right", "on", "how", "validate")


def parse_join_on(raw: str) -> tuple[list[str] | None, list[str] | None, list[str] | None]:
    """Parse -join's on= value: shared column names (comma list) when names match on
    both sides, or 'left:right' pairs when they differ between sides. Quote the whole
    on= value if it has more than one column/pair (protects the inner commas), e.g.
    on='col a:cola,colb:colb'. Returns (on_cols, left_cols, right_cols) — on_cols is
    set XOR (left_cols, right_cols) are set.
    """
    pairs = [p.strip() for p in raw.split(",") if p.strip()]
    if not pairs:
        raise SystemExit("-join: on= needs at least one column (or left:right pair)")
    has_colon = [":" in p for p in pairs]
    if any(has_colon) and not all(has_colon):
        raise SystemExit("-join: on= mixes plain columns and left:right pairs; use one style")
    if all(has_colon):
        left_cols, right_cols = [], []
        for pair in pairs:
            left, _, right = pair.partition(":")
            left_cols.append(left.strip())
            right_cols.append(right.strip())
        return None, left_cols, right_cols
    return pairs, None, None


def parse_join_arg(raw: str) -> dict:
    """Parse -join as key=value tokens: left=/right= (required -file aliases, or the
    literal 'data' to reference the pipeline's current result so far — lets repeated
    -join calls fold in one more file at a time), on= (required; shared column
    name(s), or left:right pairs if they differ between sides), how= (optional,
    default 'inner', passed to Polars join()), validate= (optional, passed
    to Polars join()).
    """
    kwargs = parse_reshape_kwargs(raw, keys=_JOIN_KEYS, flag="-join")
    how = kwargs.get("how", "inner")
    required = ["left", "right"] if how == "cross" else ["left", "right", "on"]
    missing = [k for k in required if k not in kwargs]
    if missing:
        raise SystemExit(f"-join: missing required key(s): {', '.join(missing)}")
    if how == "cross":
        if "on" in kwargs:
            raise SystemExit("-join: on= cannot be used with how=cross (cross joins don't take on=)")
        on_cols, left_cols, right_cols = None, None, None
    else:
        on_cols, left_cols, right_cols = parse_join_on(kwargs["on"])
    return {
        "left": kwargs["left"],
        "right": kwargs["right"],
        "on": on_cols,
        "left_on": left_cols,
        "right_on": right_cols,
        "how": how,
        "validate": kwargs.get("validate"),
    }


_CONCAT_KEYS = ("frames",)


def parse_concat_arg(raw: str) -> dict:
    """Parse -concat as key=value tokens: frames= (required) — an ordered,
    comma-separated list of -file aliases (or 'data' for the pipeline's current
    result, to stack more files onto something already produced), e.g.
    frames='df1,df2,df3'. Quote the whole value — it has internal commas.
    """
    kwargs = parse_reshape_kwargs(raw, keys=_CONCAT_KEYS, flag="-concat")
    if "frames" not in kwargs:
        raise SystemExit("-concat: expected frames='alias1,alias2,...'")
    names = [n.strip() for n in kwargs["frames"].split(",") if n.strip()]
    if len(names) < 2:
        raise SystemExit("-concat: frames= needs at least two names")
    return {"frames": names}


def parse_kv_spec(raw: str | None, *, flag: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Parse comma-separated key=value tokens into a kwargs dict, type-casting numbers and booleans."""
    if not raw or not raw.strip():
        return {}
    kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for token in _tokenize(raw, ",", keep_quotes=True, track_brackets=True):
        token = token.strip()
        if not token:
            continue
        if "=" not in token:
            kwargs[token.strip()] = True
            continue
        key, _, raw_val = token.partition("=")
        key = key.strip()
        raw_val = raw_val.strip()
        val: Any
        if (raw_val.startswith("'") and raw_val.endswith("'")) or (raw_val.startswith('"') and raw_val.endswith('"')):
            val = raw_val[1:-1]
        elif raw_val.lower() == "true":
            val = True
        elif raw_val.lower() == "false":
            val = False
        elif raw_val.lower() in ("none", "null"):
            val = None
        else:
            try:
                val = int(raw_val)
            except ValueError:
                try:
                    val = float(raw_val)
                except ValueError:
                    val = raw_val
        kwargs[key] = val
    return kwargs


def normalize_sql(query: str) -> str:
    """Normalize SQL queries for CLI -sql: resolve @file references, convert backticks
    `col` and brackets [col] to double-quoted identifiers "col" for standard SQL."""
    q = query.strip()
    if (q.startswith("'") and q.endswith("'")) or (q.startswith('"') and q.endswith('"')):
        q = q[1:-1].strip()
    if q.startswith("@"):
        path = q[1:].strip()
        if (path.startswith("'") and path.endswith("'")) or (path.startswith('"') and path.endswith('"')):
            path = path[1:-1].strip()
        from pathlib import Path

        file_path = Path(path)
        if not file_path.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"sql: query file not found: '{path}'")
        q = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    out_chars: list[str] = []
    i, n = 0, len(q)
    quote = None
    while i < n:
        ch = q[i]
        if quote is not None:
            out_chars.append(ch)
            if ch == quote:
                if i + 1 < n and q[i + 1] == quote:
                    out_chars.append(q[i + 1])
                    i += 2
                    continue
                quote = None
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch in "'\"":
            quote = ch
            out_chars.append(ch)
            i += 1
            continue
        if ch == "`":
            j = q.find("`", i + 1)
            if j != -1:
                ident = q[i + 1 : j]
                out_chars.append(f'"{ident}"')
                i = j + 1
                continue
        if ch == "[":
            j = q.find("]", i + 1)
            if j != -1:
                inner = q[i + 1 : j]
                is_index = i > 0 and (q[i - 1].isalnum() or q[i - 1] in "_)]")
                is_list_literal = "," in inner or "'" in inner or '"' in inner
                has_ident = any(c.isalpha() or c == "_" for c in inner)
                all_valid = all(c.isalnum() or c in " _-" for c in inner)
                if not is_index and not is_list_literal and has_ident and all_valid:
                    out_chars.append(f'"{inner}"')
                    i = j + 1
                    continue

        out_chars.append(ch)
        i += 1
    return "".join(out_chars)


def parse_bar_spec(raw: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Parse -bar specification: e.g. bare (None/""), "col", "cat:val",
    "cat:val,limit=(min,max),pct=true,width=30", "limit=(0,5000),pct=true"."""
    result: dict[str, Any] = {
        "cat": None,
        "val": None,
        "limit": None,
        "pct": False,
        "width": 20,
    }
    if not raw or not raw.strip():
        return result

    tokens = _tokenize(raw.strip(), ",", keep_quotes=True, track_brackets=True)
    for token in tokens:
        token = token.strip()
        if not token:
            continue
        if "=" in token:
            key, _, val_str = token.partition("=")
            key = key.strip().lower()
            val_str = val_str.strip()
            if key == "limit":
                v = val_str.strip("()[]")
                lim_parts = [p.strip() for p in (v.split(":") if ":" in v else v.split(",")) if p.strip()]
                if len(lim_parts) == 2:
                    try:
                        result["limit"] = (float(lim_parts[0]), float(lim_parts[1]))
                    except ValueError:
                        raise SystemExit(f"-bar: invalid limit='{val_str}'; expected (min, max)")
                else:
                    raise SystemExit(f"-bar: invalid limit='{val_str}'; expected (min, max)")
            elif key == "pct":
                result["pct"] = parse_bool_text(val_str)
            elif key == "width":
                try:
                    result["width"] = int(val_str)
                except ValueError:
                    raise SystemExit(f"-bar: invalid width='{val_str}'; expected positive integer")
            elif key in ("val", "value"):
                result["val"] = _unquote_name(val_str)
            elif key in ("cat", "category"):
                result["cat"] = _unquote_name(val_str)
            else:
                raise SystemExit(f"-bar: unrecognized option '{key}'")
        else:
            if ":" in token:
                cp, _, vp = token.partition(":")
                result["cat"] = _unquote_name(cp.strip())
                result["val"] = _unquote_name(vp.strip())
            else:
                result["val"] = _unquote_name(token)
    return result


def parse_scatter_spec(raw: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Parse -scatter specification: e.g. bare (None/""), "x:y",
    "x:y,width=60,height=20,limit_x=(min,max),limit_y=(min,max)"."""
    result: dict[str, Any] = {
        "x": None,
        "y": None,
        "width": 50,
        "height": 15,
        "limit_x": None,
        "limit_y": None,
    }
    if not raw or not raw.strip():
        return result

    tokens = _tokenize(raw.strip(), ",", keep_quotes=True, track_brackets=True)
    for token in tokens:
        token = token.strip()
        if not token:
            continue
        if "=" in token:
            key, _, val_str = token.partition("=")
            key = key.strip().lower()
            val_str = val_str.strip()
            if key in ("limit_x", "xlim"):
                v = val_str.strip("()[]")
                lim_parts = [p.strip() for p in (v.split(":") if ":" in v else v.split(",")) if p.strip()]
                if len(lim_parts) == 2:
                    try:
                        result["limit_x"] = (float(lim_parts[0]), float(lim_parts[1]))
                    except ValueError:
                        raise SystemExit(f"-scatter: invalid limit_x='{val_str}'; expected (min, max)")
                else:
                    raise SystemExit(f"-scatter: invalid limit_x='{val_str}'; expected (min, max)")
            elif key in ("limit_y", "ylim"):
                v = val_str.strip("()[]")
                lim_parts = [p.strip() for p in (v.split(":") if ":" in v else v.split(",")) if p.strip()]
                if len(lim_parts) == 2:
                    try:
                        result["limit_y"] = (float(lim_parts[0]), float(lim_parts[1]))
                    except ValueError:
                        raise SystemExit(f"-scatter: invalid limit_y='{val_str}'; expected (min, max)")
                else:
                    raise SystemExit(f"-scatter: invalid limit_y='{val_str}'; expected (min, max)")
            elif key == "width":
                try:
                    result["width"] = int(val_str)
                except ValueError:
                    raise SystemExit(f"-scatter: invalid width='{val_str}'; expected positive integer")
            elif key == "height":
                try:
                    result["height"] = int(val_str)
                except ValueError:
                    raise SystemExit(f"-scatter: invalid height='{val_str}'; expected positive integer")
            elif key == "x":
                result["x"] = _unquote_name(val_str)
            elif key == "y":
                result["y"] = _unquote_name(val_str)
            else:
                raise SystemExit(f"-scatter: unrecognized option '{key}'")
        else:
            if ":" in token:
                xp, _, yp = token.partition(":")
                result["x"] = _unquote_name(xp.strip())
                result["y"] = _unquote_name(yp.strip())
            else:
                result["x"] = _unquote_name(token)
    return result


def parse_corr_spec(raw: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Parse -corr specification: e.g. bare (None/""), "pairs", "target=col",
    "method=spearman", "pairs,method=spearman"."""
    result: dict[str, Any] = {
        "target": None,
        "pairs": False,
        "method": "pearson",
    }
    if not raw or not raw.strip():
        return result

    tokens = _tokenize(raw.strip(), ",", keep_quotes=True, track_brackets=True)
    for token in tokens:
        token = token.strip()
        if not token:
            continue
        if "=" in token:
            key, _, val_str = token.partition("=")
            key = key.strip().lower()
            val_str = val_str.strip()
            if key in ("target", "y"):
                result["target"] = _unquote_name(val_str)
            elif key == "method":
                m = val_str.lower().strip()
                if m not in ("pearson", "spearman"):
                    raise SystemExit(f"-corr: invalid method '{val_str}'; expected 'pearson' or 'spearman'")
                result["method"] = m
            elif key == "pairs":
                result["pairs"] = parse_bool_text(val_str)
            else:
                raise SystemExit(f"-corr: unrecognized option '{key}'")
        else:
            t_lower = token.lower()
            if t_lower == "pairs":
                result["pairs"] = True
            elif t_lower in ("pearson", "spearman"):
                result["method"] = t_lower
            else:
                result["target"] = _unquote_name(token)
    return result

"""The _Pipeline view and the argparse Actions that record CLI flag order (op_order)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
from typing import Any

import pandas as pd

from pytae._text import unquote_name as _unquote_name
from pytae.cli_parsing import _select_unknown_names, unknown_columns_message


def _mask_quoted(spec: str) -> str:
    """Blank out the contents of quoted substrings in spec (keeping overall length/
    positions), so a regex check on the result only ever sees text outside string
    literals -- e.g. an '@' inside a quoted value like 'a@b' is masked out."""
    out = []
    quote: str | None = None
    for ch in spec:
        if quote:
            out.append(ch if ch == quote else " ")
            if ch == quote:
                quote = None
            continue
        if ch in "'\"":
            quote = ch
        out.append(ch)
    return "".join(out)


class _Pipeline:
    """Flag order is the method chain. Each -select/-qry/-query/-head/… call
    runs on the current view, same as pt.select(df, …) then pt.qry(df, …) then head.
    Only the last flag prints. Schema-only ops (-cols/-dtype/-shape) avoid loading
    row data until something actually requires it. -shape/-cols/-dtype/-nulls/-info
    don't return a DataFrame/Series in pandas either, so (like main()'s validation)
    nothing may follow them except -o clip.
    """

    def __init__(self, reader=None, *, nrows=None, progress=False, frames=None, chunk_size: int = 200_000) -> None:
        self._reader = reader
        self._nrows = nrows
        self._progress = progress
        self._chunk_size = chunk_size
        self._pandas_df: pd.DataFrame | None = None
        self._pldf: Any | None = None
        self._pending_exact: list[str] | None = None
        self._frames: dict[str, Any] = frames or {}
        self._last_sort_cols: list[str] | None = None
        self._last_sort_desc: list[bool] | None = None

    @property
    def _df(self) -> pd.DataFrame | None:
        return self._pandas_df

    @_df.setter
    def _df(self, value: pd.DataFrame | None) -> None:
        self._pandas_df = value
        if value is not None:
            self._pldf = None

    def _available_columns(self) -> list[str]:
        if self._pldf is not None:
            if hasattr(self._pldf, "collect_schema"):
                return list(self._pldf.collect_schema().names())
            return list(self._pldf.columns)
        if self._df is not None:
            return list(self._df.columns)
        if self._pending_exact is not None:
            return list(self._pending_exact)
        return list(self._reader.columns())

    def polars_lazy_frame(self):
        """Get the current view as a LazyFrame (or converted to lazy if already eager)."""
        import polars as pl

        if self._pldf is None:
            if self._df is not None:
                self._pldf = pl.from_pandas(self._df).lazy()
            elif self._reader is not None:
                try:
                    if hasattr(self._reader, "to_polars_lazy") and not self._progress and self._nrows is None:
                        self._pldf = self._reader.to_polars_lazy(columns=self._pending_exact)
                    else:
                        eager = self._reader.to_polars(columns=self._pending_exact, nrows=self._nrows)
                        self._pldf = eager.lazy() if isinstance(eager, pl.DataFrame) else eager
                    self._pending_exact = None
                except Exception:
                    df = self.dataframe()
                    self._pldf = pl.from_pandas(df).lazy()
            else:
                self._pldf = pl.LazyFrame()
        elif isinstance(self._pldf, pl.DataFrame):
            self._pldf = self._pldf.lazy()
        return self._pldf

    def polars_frame(self):
        """Get the active frame collected into an eager Polars DataFrame."""
        import polars as pl

        lf = self.polars_lazy_frame()
        if isinstance(lf, pl.LazyFrame):
            try:
                self._pldf = lf.collect()
            except pl.exceptions.ComputeError:
                try:
                    if hasattr(self._reader, "to_polars"):
                        self._pldf = self._reader.to_polars(
                            columns=self._pending_exact, nrows=self._nrows, infer_schema_length=None
                        )
                    else:
                        raise
                except Exception:
                    df = self.dataframe()
                    self._pldf = pl.from_pandas(df)
            except Exception:
                df = self.dataframe()
                self._pldf = pl.from_pandas(df)
        return self._pldf

    def apply_select(self, names: list[str], kwargs: dict) -> str | None:
        """Apply one -select spec to the current view. Returns an error message or None."""
        available = self._available_columns()
        unknown = _select_unknown_names(names, available)
        if unknown:
            return unknown_columns_message("-select", unknown, available)

        needs_frame = (
            self._pldf is not None
            or self._df is not None
            or bool(kwargs)
            or any(":" in token for token in names)
            or any(token.startswith(("-", "~", "!")) for token in names)
        )
        if not needs_frame:
            self._pending_exact = [_unquote_name(n) for n in names]
            return None

        try:
            from pytae.polars_engine import select_polars

            self._pldf = select_polars(self.polars_lazy_frame(), names, kwargs)
            self._df = None
            return None
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"-select: {exc}"

    def apply_rename(self, mapping: dict[str, str]) -> str | None:
        """Apply one -rename mapping to the current view. Returns an error message or None."""
        available = self._available_columns()
        unknown = [c for c in mapping if c not in available]
        if unknown:
            return unknown_columns_message("-rename", unknown, available)
        try:
            from pytae.polars_engine import rename_polars

            self._pldf = rename_polars(self.polars_lazy_frame(), mapping)
            self._df = None
            return None
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"-rename: {exc}"

    def apply_filter(self, conditions: Any, flag_name: str = "-filter") -> str | None:
        """Apply one -filter (or -qry) spec to the current view. Returns an error message or None."""
        available = self._available_columns()
        if hasattr(conditions, "columns"):
            cond_cols = conditions.columns()
        elif isinstance(conditions, dict):
            cond_cols = list(conditions.keys())
        elif isinstance(conditions, list):
            cond_cols = []
            for item in conditions:
                if hasattr(item, "columns"):
                    cond_cols.extend(item.columns())
                elif isinstance(item, tuple) and len(item) == 2:
                    cond_cols.append(item[0])
        else:
            cond_cols = []

        def _get_base_col(c: str) -> str:
            if ".dt." in c:
                return c.split(".dt.")[0].strip()
            if ".str." in c:
                return c.split(".str.")[0].strip()
            return c.strip("[]").strip()

        unknown = [_get_base_col(c) for c in cond_cols if _get_base_col(c) not in available]
        if unknown:
            return unknown_columns_message(flag_name, unknown, available)

        try:
            from pytae.polars_engine import filter_polars

            self._pldf = filter_polars(self.polars_lazy_frame(), conditions)
            self._df = None
            return None
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"{flag_name}: {exc}"

    def apply_mutate(self, spec: str, by: list[str] | None = None, dropna: bool = False) -> str | None:
        """Apply one -mutate spec to the current view. Returns an error message or None."""
        raw_spec = spec.strip()
        if (raw_spec.startswith("'") and raw_spec.endswith("'")) or (
            raw_spec.startswith('"') and raw_spec.endswith('"')
        ):
            raw_spec = raw_spec[1:-1].strip()
        if raw_spec.startswith("@"):
            path = raw_spec[1:].strip()
            if (path.startswith("'") and path.endswith("'")) or (path.startswith('"') and path.endswith('"')):
                path = path[1:-1].strip()
            from pathlib import Path

            file_path = Path(path)
            if not file_path.is_file():
                return f"-mutate: spec file not found: '{path}'"
            try:
                raw_spec = file_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
            except Exception as exc:
                return f"-mutate: failed to read spec file '{path}': {exc}"
        if re.search(r"@\w", _mask_quoted(raw_spec)):
            return "-mutate: '@name' local-variable references are library-only (pt.mutate() from Python), not available on the CLI"
        from pytae._parsing import parse_mutate_spec

        try:
            parsed = parse_mutate_spec(raw_spec)
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"-mutate: {exc}"

        try:
            from pytae.polars_engine import mutate_polars

            self._pldf = mutate_polars(self.polars_lazy_frame(), parsed, by=by, dropna=dropna)
            self._df = None
            return None
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"-mutate: {exc}"

    def apply_dropna(self, spec: str | None) -> str | None:
        """Drop rows containing missing values (null/NaN). Returns an error message or None."""
        from pytae.cli_parsing import parse_dropna_spec, unknown_columns_message

        available = self._available_columns()
        try:
            cols, how, drop_nans = parse_dropna_spec(spec, flag_name="-dropna", available_cols=available)
        except SystemExit as exc:
            return str(exc)

        if cols:
            unknown = [c for c in cols if c not in available]
            if unknown:
                return unknown_columns_message("-dropna", unknown, available)

        try:
            from pytae.polars_engine import dropna_polars

            self._pldf = dropna_polars(
                self.polars_lazy_frame(),
                cols=cols if cols else None,
                how=how,
                drop_nans=drop_nans,
            )
            self._df = None
            return None
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"-dropna: {exc}"

    def apply_distinct(self, spec: str | None) -> str | None:
        """Drop duplicate rows. Returns an error message or None."""
        from pytae.cli_parsing import parse_distinct_spec, unknown_columns_message

        try:
            cols, keep = parse_distinct_spec(spec)
        except SystemExit as exc:
            return str(exc)
        available = self._available_columns()
        if cols:
            unknown = [c for c in cols if c not in available]
            if unknown:
                return unknown_columns_message("-distinct", unknown, available)
        try:
            from pytae.polars_engine import distinct_polars

            self._pldf = distinct_polars(self.polars_lazy_frame(), cols=cols, keep=keep)
            self._df = None
            return None
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"-distinct: {exc}"

    def apply_count(self, spec: str | None, by_cols: list[str] | None = None) -> str | None:
        """Count occurrences of combinations of columns or within groups. Returns an error message or None."""
        from pytae.cli_parsing import parse_count_spec, unknown_columns_message

        try:
            cols, sort, name = parse_count_spec(spec)
        except SystemExit as exc:
            return str(exc)
        if by_cols and not cols:
            cols = list(by_cols)
        available = self._available_columns()
        if cols:
            unknown = [c for c in cols if c not in available]
            if unknown:
                return unknown_columns_message("-count", unknown, available)
        try:
            from pytae.polars_engine import count_polars

            self._pldf = count_polars(self.polars_lazy_frame(), cols=cols, sort=sort, name=name)
            self._df = None
            return None
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"-count: {exc}"

    def apply_arrange(self, spec: str) -> str | None:
        """Sort rows by one or more columns with directions. Returns an error message or None."""
        try:
            from pytae._parsing import _extract_arrange_specs
            from pytae.polars_engine import arrange_polars

            cols, asc = _extract_arrange_specs((spec,), available_cols=set(self._available_columns()))
            descending = [not a for a in asc]
            self._last_sort_cols = cols
            self._last_sort_desc = descending

            self._pldf = arrange_polars(self.polars_lazy_frame(), spec)
            self._df = None
            return None
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"-arrange: {exc}"

    def apply_pick(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> str:
        return "'-pick' has been removed; use '-arrange ... -head N' (or '-by ... -arrange ... -head N') instead."

    def apply_fillna(self, value: Any, cols: list[str] | None = None, nans: bool = True) -> str | None:
        """Apply one -fillna operation to the current view. Returns an error message or None."""
        available = self._available_columns()
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            unknown = [c for c in value if c not in available]
            if unknown:
                return unknown_columns_message("-fillna", unknown, available)
        elif cols:
            unknown = [c for c in cols if c not in available]
            if unknown:
                return unknown_columns_message("-fillna", unknown, available)
        try:
            from pytae.polars_engine import fillna_polars

            self._pldf = fillna_polars(self.polars_lazy_frame(), value, *(cols or ()), nans=nans)
            self._df = None
            return None
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"-fillna: {exc}"

    def apply_mask(
        self,
        spec: Any,
        *,
        key: str | None = None,
        salt: str | None = None,
        vault: Any = None,
        redact_val: str = "***",
    ) -> str | None:
        """Apply -mask to the current view. Returns an error message or None."""
        from pytae.mask import mask_polars, parse_mask_spec

        if key is not None:
            default_m = "encrypt"
        elif vault is not None:
            default_m = "tokenize"
        else:
            default_m = "hash"

        try:
            mapping = parse_mask_spec(spec, default_method=default_m)
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"-mask: {exc}"

        available = self._available_columns()
        missing = [c for c in mapping if c not in available]
        if missing:
            return unknown_columns_message("-mask", missing, available)

        try:
            self._pldf = mask_polars(
                self.polars_lazy_frame(), mapping, key=key, salt=salt, vault=vault, redact_val=redact_val
            )
            self._df = None
            return None
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"-mask: {exc}"

    def apply_unmask(
        self,
        cols: Any,
        *,
        key: str | None = None,
        vault: Any = None,
    ) -> str | None:
        """Apply -unmask to the current view. Returns an error message or None."""
        from pytae.mask import parse_unmask_spec, unmask_polars

        col_list = parse_unmask_spec(cols)
        if not col_list:
            return "-unmask: expected at least one column name"

        available = self._available_columns()
        missing = [c for c in col_list if c not in available]
        if missing:
            return unknown_columns_message("-unmask", missing, available)

        try:
            self._pldf = unmask_polars(self.polars_lazy_frame(), col_list, key=key, vault=vault)
            self._df = None
            return None
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"-unmask: {exc}"

    def apply_sql(self, query: str) -> str | None:
        """Apply one -sql query via Polars SQLContext. Single-file mode: the current view is registered
        as table `data` (the file itself is already named on the command line, so there's no
        separate file-derived alias).
        -file/-join mode: every -file alias is registered under its own name instead, so
        -sql can do the join itself; `data` is also registered once something (e.g. -join)
        has produced a current view. Returns an error message or None."""
        import re

        import polars as pl

        from pytae.cli_parsing import normalize_sql

        try:
            normalized_query = normalize_sql(query)
        except Exception as exc:
            return f"-sql: {exc}"
        polars_query = re.sub(r"\bin\s*\[(.*?)\]", r"in (\1)", normalized_query, flags=re.IGNORECASE)

        try:
            if self._progress and self._reader is not None:
                self.dataframe()
            tables: dict[str, pl.DataFrame] = {}
            for alias, frame in self._frames.items():
                tables[alias] = pl.from_pandas(frame) if isinstance(frame, pd.DataFrame) else frame
            tables["data"] = self.polars_frame()
            ctx = pl.SQLContext(frames=tables)
            res_pl = ctx.execute(polars_query).collect()
            self._pldf = res_pl
            self._df = None
            return None
        except Exception as polars_err:
            return f"-sql: {polars_err}"

    def dataframe(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if self._pandas_df is None:
            import polars as pl

            if isinstance(self._pldf, pl.DataFrame):
                self._pandas_df = self._pldf.to_pandas()
            else:
                df = self._reader.to_dataframe(
                    columns=self._pending_exact,
                    nrows=self._nrows,
                    progress=self._progress,
                    chunk_size=self._chunk_size,
                )
                self._pandas_df = df
        return self._pandas_df

    def columns(self) -> list[str]:
        if self._pldf is not None:
            if hasattr(self._pldf, "collect_schema"):
                return list(self._pldf.collect_schema().names())
            return list(self._pldf.columns)
        if self._df is not None:
            return list(self._df.columns)
        return self._available_columns()

    def dtypes(self) -> pd.Series:
        if self._pldf is not None:
            if hasattr(self._pldf, "collect"):
                return self._pldf.head(0).collect().to_pandas().dtypes
            return self._pldf.head(0).to_pandas().dtypes
        if self._df is not None:
            return self._df.dtypes
        dtypes = self._reader.dtypes()
        return dtypes[self._pending_exact] if self._pending_exact is not None else dtypes

    def shape(self) -> tuple[int, int]:
        if self._pldf is not None:
            if hasattr(self._pldf, "collect"):
                import polars as pl

                return (
                    self._pldf.select(pl.len()).collect().item(),
                    len(self._pldf.collect_schema().names()),
                )
            return self._pldf.shape
        if self._df is not None:
            return self._df.shape
        rows = self._reader.shape()[0]
        cols = len(self._pending_exact) if self._pending_exact is not None else self._reader.shape()[1]
        return (rows, cols)

    def current_frame(self) -> Any:
        """Return the active frame (preferring Polars to avoid needless Pandas conversions)."""
        if self._progress:
            return self.dataframe()
        if self._df is not None:
            return self._df
        return self.polars_frame()

    def head(self, val: Any = 5, *, by: list[str] | None = None) -> Any:
        from pytae.cli_parsing import SliceSpec, parse_head_limit
        from pytae.polars_engine import slice_head_polars

        spec = parse_head_limit(val, flag_name="-head") if not isinstance(val, SliceSpec) else val
        lf = self.polars_lazy_frame()
        res = slice_head_polars(
            lf,
            n=spec.n,
            prop=spec.prop,
            with_ties=spec.with_ties,
            by=by,
            sort_cols=self._last_sort_cols,
            sort_desc=self._last_sort_desc,
        )
        if self._progress:
            self._df = res.collect().to_pandas() if hasattr(res, "collect") else res.to_pandas()
            self._pldf = None
            return self._df
        self._pldf = res.collect() if hasattr(res, "collect") else res
        self._df = None
        return self._pldf

    def tail(self, val: Any = 5, *, by: list[str] | None = None) -> Any:
        from pytae.cli_parsing import SliceSpec, parse_head_limit
        from pytae.polars_engine import slice_tail_polars

        spec = parse_head_limit(val, flag_name="-tail") if not isinstance(val, SliceSpec) else val
        lf = self.polars_lazy_frame()
        res = slice_tail_polars(
            lf,
            n=spec.n,
            prop=spec.prop,
            with_ties=spec.with_ties,
            by=by,
            sort_cols=self._last_sort_cols,
            sort_desc=self._last_sort_desc,
        )
        if self._progress:
            self._df = res.collect().to_pandas() if hasattr(res, "collect") else res.to_pandas()
            self._pldf = None
            return self._df
        self._pldf = res.collect() if hasattr(res, "collect") else res
        self._df = None
        return self._pldf

    def sample(self, n: int, *, seed: int | None = None, frac: float | None = None) -> Any:
        if self._progress:
            df = self.dataframe()
            if not (isinstance(df.index, pd.RangeIndex) and df.index.name is None):
                df = df.reset_index()
            if frac is not None:
                sampled = df.sample(frac=frac, random_state=seed)
            else:
                n = min(n, len(df))
                sampled = df.sample(n=n, random_state=seed) if n else df.iloc[0:0]
            sampled = sampled.reset_index(drop=True)
            self._df = sampled
            self._pldf = None
            return sampled

        pldf = self.polars_frame()
        if frac is not None:
            sampled_pl = pldf.sample(fraction=frac, seed=seed)
        else:
            n_rows = len(pldf)
            sample_n = min(n, n_rows)
            sampled_pl = pldf.sample(n=sample_n, seed=seed) if sample_n > 0 else pldf.head(0)
        self._pldf = sampled_pl
        self._df = None
        return sampled_pl


class _OrderedFlag(argparse.Action):
    """Boolean flag (like store_true) that also records its dest in namespace.op_order, in CLI order."""

    def __init__(self, option_strings, dest, **kwargs) -> None:
        super().__init__(option_strings, dest, nargs=0, default=False, **kwargs)

    def __call__(self, parser, namespace, values, option_string=None) -> None:
        setattr(namespace, self.dest, True)
        namespace.op_order = getattr(namespace, "op_order", []) + [self.dest]


class _OrderedValue(argparse.Action):
    """Optional-value flag (nargs='?') that also records its dest in namespace.op_order, in CLI order."""

    def __call__(self, parser, namespace, values, option_string=None) -> None:
        val = self.const if values is None else values
        setattr(namespace, self.dest, val)
        flag_name = option_string.lstrip("-") if option_string else self.dest
        namespace.op_order = getattr(namespace, "op_order", []) + [flag_name]
        op_values = getattr(namespace, "_op_values", None)
        if op_values is None:
            op_values = {}
            setattr(namespace, "_op_values", op_values)
        op_values.setdefault(flag_name, []).append(val)
        if flag_name != self.dest:
            op_values.setdefault(self.dest, []).append(val)


class _OrderedStore(argparse.Action):
    """Required-value flag (nargs=default) that also records its dest in namespace.op_order, in CLI order."""

    def __call__(self, parser, namespace, values, option_string=None) -> None:
        setattr(namespace, self.dest, values)
        flag_name = option_string.lstrip("-") if option_string else self.dest
        namespace.op_order = getattr(namespace, "op_order", []) + [flag_name]
        op_values = getattr(namespace, "_op_values", None)
        if op_values is None:
            op_values = {}
            setattr(namespace, "_op_values", op_values)
        op_values.setdefault(flag_name, []).append(values)
        if flag_name != self.dest:
            op_values.setdefault(self.dest, []).append(values)


class _OrderedAppend(argparse.Action):
    """Collect repeated flags into a list and record each occurrence in op_order."""

    def __call__(self, parser, namespace, values, option_string=None) -> None:
        items = getattr(namespace, self.dest, None)
        items = [] if items is None else list(items)
        items.append(values)
        setattr(namespace, self.dest, items)
        flag_name = option_string.lstrip("-") if option_string else self.dest
        namespace.op_order = getattr(namespace, "op_order", []) + [flag_name]

    parse_clean_columns_arg,
    parse_columns,
    parse_fillna_spec,
    parse_kv_spec,
    parse_long_arg,
    parse_pivot_arg,
    parse_wide_arg,
    unknown_columns_message,
)

def _apply_round(df: Any, ndigits: int | None) -> Any:
    """Round numeric columns to ndigits; non-numeric columns pass through unchanged."""
    import polars as pl

    from pytae.dataframe import DataFrame as PytaeDataFrame

    if isinstance(df, PytaeDataFrame):
        df = df._df
    if isinstance(df, pl.LazyFrame):
        df = df.collect()
    if ndigits is None:
        return df
    if isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
        return df.round(ndigits)
    try:
        import polars.selectors as cs

        if isinstance(df, pl.DataFrame):
            return df.with_columns(cs.numeric().round(ndigits))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return df


def _format_table(
    df: Any,
    *,
    index: bool | None = None,
    pretty: bool = False,
    is_tty: bool | None = None,
) -> str:
    """Render tabular data directly using Polars.

    Auto-detects TTY output:
    - Interactive terminal (isatty): renders Polars default boxed table with shape & dtypes.
    - Piped / redirected (not isatty): renders bare unbordered plain text without shape or dtype headers.
    """
    if is_tty is None:
        is_tty = hasattr(sys.stdout, "isatty") and sys.stdout.isatty()

    import polars as pl

    from pytae.dataframe import DataFrame as PytaeDataFrame

    if isinstance(df, PytaeDataFrame):
        df = df._df

    if isinstance(df, pl.LazyFrame):
        df = df.collect()

    if is_tty:
        if isinstance(df, pl.DataFrame):
            pldf = df
        elif isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
            if index is None:
                index = not (isinstance(df.index, pd.RangeIndex) and df.index.name is None)
            try:
                pldf = pl.from_pandas(df.reset_index() if index else df)
            except Exception:
                return df.to_string(index=index)
        else:
            return str(df)

        n_rows = len(pldf)
        tbl_rows = max(n_rows, 10) if n_rows <= 250 else 10
        with pl.Config(tbl_rows=tbl_rows):
            return str(pldf)

    # Non-TTY / Piped / Redirected: Bare output
    if isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame):
        if index is None:
            index = not (isinstance(df.index, pd.RangeIndex) and df.index.name is None)
        return df.to_string(index=index)

    if isinstance(df, pl.DataFrame):
        if len(df) == 0:
            return f"Empty DataFrame\nColumns: {list(df.columns)}\nIndex: []"
        if len(df) <= 1000:
            return df.to_pandas().to_string(index=False)
        with pl.Config(
            tbl_formatting="NOTHING",
            tbl_hide_column_data_types=True,
            tbl_hide_dataframe_shape=True,
            tbl_width_chars=10_000,
            tbl_rows=-1,
            tbl_cols=-1,
        ):
            return "\n".join(line.strip() for line in str(df).splitlines())

    return str(df)


def _compute_freq(source_df: Any, col: str | None, dropna: bool) -> Any:
    from pytae.other_utilities import freq

    width = 20
    target_col = col
    if col and ",width=" in col:
        c_part, _, w_part = col.partition(",width=")
        target_col = c_part.strip()
        try:
            width = int(w_part.strip())
        except ValueError:
            raise SystemExit(f"-freq: invalid width='{w_part.strip()}'; expected positive integer")
    try:
        return freq(source_df, col=target_col, dropna=dropna, width=width)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise SystemExit(str(exc))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise SystemExit(f"-freq: {exc}")


def _compute_hist(source_df: Any, hist_arg: str | None) -> Any:
    from pytae.other_utilities import hist

    width = 20
    target_arg = hist_arg
    if hist_arg and ",width=" in hist_arg:
        h_part, _, w_part = hist_arg.partition(",width=")
        target_arg = h_part.strip()
        try:
            width = int(w_part.strip())
        except ValueError:
            raise SystemExit(f"-hist: invalid width='{w_part.strip()}'; expected positive integer")
    try:
        return hist(source_df, col=target_arg, width=width)
    except KeyError as exc:
        raise SystemExit(str(exc))
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise SystemExit(f"-hist: {exc}")
